# tg — Telegram CLI for AI agents

The full guide lives at **[wirecat.dev/en/docs/tg](https://wirecat.dev/en/docs/tg)**. These wiki pages
copy the [`docs/` folder](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/tg-cli/tree/main/docs) on every change to `main`,
so an edit made here is overwritten. To fix a page, open a pull request against `docs/`.

Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/tg-cli/discussions). What changed in each
version: [releases](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/tg-cli/releases). `tg` is part of
[WireCat](https://wirecat.dev).
